g.text: Note: Document processing, business process work and data analysis lead the API and barely register on Claude.ai, where content creation,

g.text: learning and hobbies dominate. The same model, bought two different ways. The chart sets the two files side by side and does not

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: combine them. The 1P API file is Anthropic's own API traffic excluding Claude Code, published globally with no geographic breakdown.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: It is a different population from Claude.ai and the two are never pooled. A cell Anthropic did not publish is absent, not zero: a

g.text: value is released only where it clears an aggregation threshold and a geography sample floor.
